privacy.title: Privacy notice
body: Radiant Advising Services collects only the details you send through our forms (name, company, email, phone and your message) to respond to your inquiry and to prepare trade proposals.

We do not sell your data. Form submissions are stored by our hosting provider (Netlify) and in our business email. We keep them only as long as needed for the business relationship or as required by law.
If analytics is enabled, it is loaded only after you accept it in the cookie banner.
You can ask us to access, correct or delete your data at any time using the contact details on this website.

consent.text: We use analytics cookies to understand site usage, only with your consent.
